description: The Usage tab cannot answer 'am I near my limit?'. Storage is shown without the plan allowance ('account limits apply' per drive), there are no bars or percentages, and the EGRESS & COST card carries a button instead of a number. The user must click through to Billing to learn that 5.0 GiB is included.
expected: '9.7 KB of 5.0 GiB' with a bar, plus drives used of 3, operations of 1,000,000 and downloads of allowance.
suggested_fix: Show used / included on each stat card and replace the EGRESS card with downloads used of allowance.

criterion: One way per task / component consistency
description: Usage and Billing show the same data with different units (KB vs KiB: 9.7 KB / 8.9 KB vs 9.7 KiB / 8.8 KiB), different names ('Usage by author' vs 'Usage by agent', STORAGE vs RETAINED STORAGE) and different chrome (in-console tab vs separate page headed 'Settings'). A user comparing the two sees mismatched numbers for the same quantity.
expected: One unit system and one name for the per-agent table; ideally one surface.
suggested_fix: Use the same formatter (KiB) and merge the per-agent table into Billing or link the two.

description: API OPERATIONS counts the owner's own console reads: the 'Console' row has 477 of 619 operations (77%) after normal browsing, so the headline number measures the owner's clicking, not what the agents did. Seven agent rows are all zeros and the table is sorted alphabetically with Console in the middle.
expected: Exclude console reads from the headline or show them separately; sort by usage, hide zero rows.
suggested_fix: Do not meter console list calls; sort by storage descending.

description: In the 'Usage by author' table every first-column cell has a solid dark bottom border (rgb 17,17,17) while the rest of the row uses a 9% grey line, so a black stub appears under each agent name.
expected: Row separators all the same light grey.
actual: Computed border-bottom on first td: 1px rgb(17,17,17); other tds rgba(17,17,17,0.09).
suggested_fix: Remove the th-style border from td:first-child (likely the row-header style leaking into data cells).

description: On Billing, OBSERVED DOWNLOADS displays 'Not connected' as the large figure, which looks like a failure on a working Free plan, while its caption reports '2.5 KiB authorized this month'. The Usage tab calls the same area 'EGRESS & COST' and shows no figure; the Billing header link is called 'Settings' while the sidebar says 'Activity & deletion'.
expected: Show a number (authorized downloads) as the headline with 'transfer reports not connected' as a small note; consistent page names.
suggested_fix: Swap the headline and caption; rename header link.
